decisions.reason: Confirmed a nonfatal title/interface mismatch: def-ck-euclidean-maps-and-diffeomorphisms defines smooth as C-infinity, whereas the Definition explicitly requires only continuous state/control derivatives through order three. Removed Smooth from the display title; the Definition, derivative assumptions and content contract are unchanged.

The stage equations and quadrature queried f,L on domains [0,T] x Omega_x x Omega_u but restricted only time. For example f defined only on Omega_x=(-1,1) cannot be queried at a trial stage X=2. Added start, control and every-stage membership checks before queries, including implicit trial stages; no existence or convergence claim was added.

Confirmed a nonfatal omitted routine derivation: scalar Minkowski alone does not literally assert the vector-valued L2 triangle inequality used in steps 1.2 and 2.1. F4 now derives it by pointwise Euclidean triangle, squaring/integral monotonicity, and scalar Minkowski on the two scalar norm functions. Nearest-point separation, averaging contraction and step-function density prove the unchanged recovery statement under the original Countable Choice assumption.

The admitted optional terminal constraints can change transversality: on [0,1], minimize integral u^2/2 with x prime=u, x(0)=0, x(1)=a nonzero, phi=0, and U_c=[-2|a|,2|a|]. Its interior minimizer u=a has constant adjoint p=-a, contradicting the displayed p(1)=0. Restricted this free-terminal residual to branches without active endpoint constraints, explicitly excluding extra endpoint equalities and requiring optional inequalities strictly inactive. The square BVP, supplied differentiable IVP evaluator and inherited numerical-residual status remain intact.

Confirmed undefined terminal-cost queries at infeasible multiple-shooting/collocation candidates: on one cell take Omega_x=(-1,1), f=L=0, x0=0, u=0 and phi(x)=log(1-x^2). Candidate X_{N,0}=2 has computed endpoint Phi_0=0, so every former stage/endpoint check passed but phi(2) is undefined. Added a check of the actual independent terminal node before phi/terminal constraints, plus actual endpoint-constraint argument checks covering optional endpoint controls. Construction returns stage-domain-failure and no objective candidate on failure; feasible equations and objective are unchanged.

Confirmed a supplier-precondition defect: the primal-dual solver Definition explicitly requires integer N>=0, and the merit globalization Definition requires finite integer R,J_max>=1. The dispatcher admitted fractional caps and its own k=K stopping test likewise needs integer K. Typed K,N as finite nonnegative integers and R,J_max as finite positive integers. Integer zero K/N still audit the initial candidate before budget termination; every solver call now respects the supplier cap interface.
